speaker: consultant
text: Good morning, this is Elena Ward.

speaker: customer
text: Good morning, Elena! It is Michael Torres. I just have a couple of quick questions, nothing urgent.

speaker: consultant
text: Hi Michael, always happy to help. What is on your mind?

speaker: customer
text: First, I am going on vacation in two weeks. Our session is planned for the day I leave. Can we move it?

speaker: consultant
text: Of course. Since it is more than forty-eight hours away, moving it is completely free.

speaker: customer
text: Great. Could we do it the Friday before instead?

speaker: consultant
text: Let me check. Friday the thirteenth, I have eleven in the morning or three in the afternoon.

speaker: customer
text: Eleven works better for me.

speaker: consultant
text: Done, Friday at eleven. I will update the calendar invite.

speaker: customer
text: Thanks. Second question. My accountant asked about your invoices. When exactly are they due?

speaker: consultant
text: All invoices are due within fourteen days of the invoice date.

speaker: customer
text: And she asked if bank transfer is okay, because the company card has a low limit.

speaker: consultant
text: Yes, bank transfer is fine. The bank details are at the bottom of every invoice.

speaker: customer
text: Perfect. Last thing. While I am away, can I still email you if something comes up at work?

speaker: consultant
text: Yes. As part of your retainer you have email support, and I reply within one business day, Monday to Friday.

speaker: customer
text: So if I email on a Saturday, I hear back on Monday.

speaker: consultant
text: Exactly. My working hours are nine to six on weekdays.

speaker: customer
text: That is totally fine. I just wanted to know what to expect.

speaker: consultant
text: Of course. Is there anything else?

speaker: customer
text: No, that was everything. Thanks for being so flexible.

speaker: consultant
text: My pleasure, Michael. Enjoy your vacation, and see you Friday at eleven.
